The Chinese characters for Cynthia

As a transliteration, Cynthia is usually written 辛西娅 (Xīn xī yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

辛
Xīn
bitter, laborious
西
xī
west
娅
yà
aunt by marriage (in names)

Origin and meaning

Cynthia is a Greek name meaning “from Mount Cynthus (an epithet of Artemis)”.

About the name Cynthia

An epithet of Artemis, the Greek moon goddess of Mount Cynthus.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “from Mount Cynthus (an epithet of Artemis)”, a Cynthia calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
